query:
UPDATE cover_suggestions
         SET status = 'open', decided_at = NULL, created_at = now(), ol_edition_id = $3,
             ol_cover_id = $4, title = $5, authors = $6, year = $7, language = $8, reason = $9
         WHERE work_id = $1 AND ol_work_id = $2 AND status = 'closed'
         RETURNING id
